title: Phase Annealer
pages: Make phase lattice in the t8 Lattice Composer from prism core and amethyst shard. Craft the t9 Phase Annealer with one phase lattice, a diffused phase (from the Phase Diffuser), an inverted phase (from the Phase Inverter), a bound singularity, a Phase Sigil in the bottom-right slot, two glass panes, a Sheathed Nichrome Heating Element in the centre and a Lattice Composer. Make the sigil by hand: offer two more phase lattices to an Astral Font holding 360 lumen. No machine creates the sigil, so this rite gates t8 to t9. All five t9 lines converge on this one recipe. Material update: crafting slot 4 (row-major 3x3) now requires a rhenium ingot via forge:ingots/rhenium; all existing progression gates remain required.

The annealer's chamber is heated electrically, so a fuel-fired blast furnace no longer fits: it needs a Sheathed Nichrome Heating Element. Craft 2 Nichrome Charge from four nickel and one chromium ingot (forge:ingots tags, the 80/20 Ni-Cr resistance alloy). Fire a charge in the Kiln at 1000 heat for 160 ticks, which needs the Kiln Heating Coil installed, to get a Nichrome Billet. Draw the billet on the Wire Drawing Bench into 2 Nichrome Resistance Wire. Craft the element as TST / WSW / CPC: T Stainless Vessel Stock (the sheath), S Screened Silica (the packed insulating powder), W resistance wire, C copper ingots (terminals) and P a Porcelain Insulator end seal. A blast furnace, bare wire or billet is rejected. Watt density and element temperature are not simulated; the element is a crafting part, not a fuel.

Install phase lattice in the focus slot, then feed a base item to the first slot. The focus is retained after each cycle. Each recipe uses 32 FE/t for 180 ticks. Annealing copper ingot produces the phase coil for the next tier.

Twenty datapack annealing recipes make practical components. Nine iron nuggets with a retained phase lattice make two iron bars; the full nugget batch prevents a recycling gain through the Flux Rectifier. One iron ingot anneals into two chains; Flux Rectifier recovers two ingots from five chains, so the loop loses iron. Four gold ingots anneal into a clock, matching the crafting cost, so an Arc Discharger returning three ingots cannot multiply gold. Four glowstone dust with the lattice fuse back into one glowstone block, matching the four dust any splitting machine returns. Nine gold nuggets anneal into one light weighted pressure plate, the same one ingot of gold the Hot Press uses, so salvaged clock nuggets cannot grow back into extra ingots through the Arc Discharger. Two prismarine shards anneal into one prismarine crystal, the same rate as the Spectral Filter, so collapsing crystals into bricks and crushing them back always loses shards.

One redstone dust anneals into one redstone torch, the same one-to-one rate the Astral Relay uses for eight redstone, so relaying torches into repeaters and rectifying them back always loses redstone. Two clay balls anneal straight into one flower pot, saving the third brick a crafted pot costs; the Mold Caster returns only two bricks and washing bricks gives one clay ball each, so the pot loop never gains clay. Two ender pearls attune into one eye of ender; no machine returns pearls from an eye, so the row only spends pearls. Two nether quartz anneal into one conductive crystal, a late alternative to electrolysing purified salts. One glass block anneals into one tinted glass block; the Lens Collimator and Prism Polisher return glass one-for-one, so the tinting loop never multiplies glass. Two amethyst shards anneal into one spyglass; the Lens Collimator and Lens Grinder return at most two shards and the Mold Caster one, so spyglass salvage never multiplies amethyst. JEI shows the focus as retained, both inputs, output, time and FE. The arcana_industry:annealing recipe accepts ingredient, focus, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority; highest priority wins, then recipe ID. Two nether brick items anneal into one nether brick fence, cheaper than the three bricks per crafted fence; no machine salvages fences, so the row only spends bricks.

Trait rule: a product may hold only the traits of its consumed inputs plus the retained phase lattice focus (crystalline 2, resonant 2), which imprints every batch but is never used up. Tinted glass gains its resonance from the lattice; a datapack row whose product carries a trait from nowhere, such as slime ball into magma cream (no fire) or quartz into a daylight detector (no glow), pauses on status "unexplained_traits" (Product traits not in input or field) without spending FE.

Top and horizontal ports import the base or focus; bottom exports the result. Configure each face with menu buttons. Supply FE through the energy capability or crank manually. The machine pauses when output is full; inventory, energy, progress and side modes persist. Breaking returns all slots.
